## Checklist

- [ ] Tests added or updated (`pnpm test`); bug fixes include a regression test
- [ ] `pnpm lint`, `pnpm typecheck` and `pnpm --filter @sophistry/core check:examples` pass
- [ ] Changeset added with `pnpm changeset` if this changes the published package (skip for docs-only or internal changes)
- [ ] Docs updated: JSDoc on new/changed API (with an `@example`), and a gallery example under `docs/src/examples/` if it is user-visible
